Other financing = ARPA Grant 81,669 + Grant - Other 80,903 + Special Assessments levied 400. Roll-forward 1,139,278 + 1,607,020 - 3,265,519 + 22,469 - 23,144 + 2,445,000 + 162,972 = 2,088,076. Business-type from the combined proprietary statement (p16): 3,722,068 + 774,643 - 798,613 + 675 = 3,698,773 (sale of assets (1,145) kept as a negative receipt as printed). Proprietary cash flows from the Total column (p19). ending_cash = governmental funds Cash and Equivalents 1,184,425 (p3); restricted cash 756,247 separate; no prior-year balance sheet so beginning cash null. governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p2). Detail: General Fund revenues and other financing from the budget schedule (p6); expenditures from the departmental schedules pp7-11 (more detailed than the p6 summary; G&A 115,442 includes Commissions 2,645, shown separately on the fund statement as County commissions, so G&A there is 112,797); Debt Service p12, Street p13, Water p17, Sewer p18. Lines with zero actual are not recorded.
